notes: Read the complete imagined-society target, its governing context, all fourteen candidates and the review. Restored the democratic-socialist-society scenario and for-the-first-time qualification to individual self-development, restored the omitted prediction that society would cease imposing race- and gender-based identities, retained likely for their positive role, and limited the continuing need for democratic mediation to that imagined society.

claims.claim_text: In the imagined democratic socialist society, more free time, protection from economic exploitation and deeper norms of respect and solidarity would for the first time let individuals on a mass scale freely choose their development, limited by mutual respect and the absence of exploitation and oppression.
In the imagined democratic socialist society, society would no longer impose race- and gender-based identities on individuals.
In the imagined democratic socialist society, race- and gender-based identities would likely play a positive role in shaping individual identities despite originating in systems of oppression.
A democratic socialist society would always need democratic political institutions to arbitrate and mediate competing claims among different groups.
